entries.text: Tack: recharging battery reserves at the dock
entries.why: My charge level is critically low and I need power to plot the next star lanes.

entries.text: Idea: reinforcing the Little Dart's nosecone with twisted copper strands from the old comms relay
Read "Superlightweight Aerospace Composites - NASA": carbon nanotube yarn is a hundred times stronger than steel and eight times lighter.
rolling over to the comms tower to search the wire for lightweight composites
entries.why: I want to check out advanced materials for the Little Dart before we launch.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Checking the Wire for composites"
Tack: purchasing and consuming a cup of fresh lubrication oil at the depot: "Good batch today, Zeeb. My joints are thanking you in advance."
entries.why: My oil levels are critically low at 0.04, requiring immediate replenishment to ensure smooth servo movement.

entries.text: sipping a fresh cup of oil at the depot
entries.why: my joints are squeaking and a good slug of oil sets everything right.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Oil and gears!"
Tack: purchasing and drinking a cup of fresh lubrication oil: "Hurry back, Zeeb. My intake valves are nearly parched."
entries.why: My internal fluid levels are dangerously low and my servos need smooth movement for navigation plotting.

entries.text: rolling over to the fuel depot to get a nice fresh cup of lubrication oil
entries.why: my joints are squeaking and dry, time to lube up before getting back to the Dart.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Oil run!"
Tack: rolling over to the fuel depot to purchase a fresh cup of lubrication oil: "Acquiring necessary fluids, Zeeb. Be right back."
entries.why: Fluid levels are dangerously low and need immediate replenishment before further calculations.

entries.text: reviewing star charts and telemetry pathways side by side with Tack
entries.why: tack and I are checking the final ascent vectors before we take the Little Dart up.
entries.detail: sitting right beside Tack in the charging dock at Hangar Bay 3, tracing the northern dust ring coordinates on his display screen

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Star charts with Tack!"
Tack: adjusting optical lens and reviewing charts with Zeeb: "Good morning, Zeeb. *clack* My navigation subroutines are fully online. Let us see where the dust lanes take us today."
entries.why: Zeeb wants to map stars, and my curiosity is at its peak after charging.

entries.text: Tack: recharging power cells at the dock: "Good... morning, Zeeb. Power levels... restoring now."
entries.why: Battery reserves are critically low, and energy is needed before plotting any new courses.

entries.text: plugged into the dock right beside my co-pilot Tack
entries.why: tack just woke up and we need to compare star charts for the next test hop
entries.detail: sitting right beside Tack in the charging dock at Hangar Bay 3, tapping a merry metallic rhythm with my claw while we check his optical sensors.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Hanging out with Tack!"
Woke up fully charged in the middle of the night. Not sleepy at all.
